description: Create ModelOrchestrator - runs all compatible models from MatchFeatureSnapshot, collects outputs as ModelPrediction|ModelAvailability, tracks which models ran vs failed vs unavailable. Does NOT create new models or duplicate existing ones.
steps: 1. Create backend/app/prediction/model_orchestrator.py with ModelOrchestrator class. Constructor accepts: list of PredictionModel instances (poisson, dixon_coles, elo, monte_carlo, negative_binomial, form_adjusted, contextual_adjuster, logistic_regression), optional MatchFeatureSnapshot for context.
2. Add ModelOrchestrator.register_model(model: PredictionModel) to dynamically add models to the orchestrator.

3. Add ModelOrchestrator.run_all(snapshot: MatchFeatureSnapshot, match_context: Optional[Dict] = None) -> ModelOrchestrationResult. For each registered model: (a) call model.check_requirements(snapshot.to_features_dict()), (b) if requirements met: call model.predict(), (c) if requirements not met: create ModelAvailability with reason, (d) catch exceptions and convert to ModelAvailability with 'failed' reason.

4. Define ModelOrchestrationResult dataclass containing: successful_predictions: List[ModelPrediction], unavailable_models: List[ModelAvailability], failed_models: List[ModelAvailability], participating_model_ids: List[str], unavailable_model_ids: List[str], failed_model_ids: List[str], execution_metadata: Dict (timing, counts).
5. Add ModelOrchestrationResult.has_sufficient_models(min_models: int = 2) -> bool to check if enough models ran for ensemble.

6. Add helper method ModelOrchestrator.create_default_registry() -> List[PredictionModel] that instantiates all existing models with default configs (Poisson, DixonColes, Elo, MonteCarlo, etc.) - this is a convenience factory, NOT new implementations.

7. Integration: Adapt existing models if needed to implement PredictionModel interface. PoissonModel, DixonColesModel, EloRatingSystem must expose predict(features, context) -> ModelPrediction|ModelAvailability. Check existing interfaces.py to see current signatures.

8. Add unit tests in backend/tests/test_model_orchestrator.py covering: orchestrator with 3 mock models (2 succeed, 1 unavailable), orchestrator with all models failing, orchestrator with insufficient models (< 2), execution_metadata contains timing and counts, default_registry creates all 8+ models.
acceptance_criteria: ModelOrchestrator.run_all() executes all registered models without stopping on first failure
Partial model failure does not kill entire orchestration - remaining models still run
Default registry instantiates Poisson, DixonColes, Elo, MonteCarlo, NegativeBinomial, FormAdjusted, ContextualAdjuster, LogisticRegression (8 models)
Unit tests pass: pytest backend/tests/test_model_orchestrator.py -v (5+ tests)

Expected: 5+ new tests pass, orchestrator handles partial failures gracefully
